title: Insha za Kiuamilifu (Theme 2: Mazoezi ya viungo vya mwili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads the letter received, lists its questions and points, and plans a reply that answers each in the friendly layout.
representations: a letter received with questions underlined

board.do: Point at the first question in the letter.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child lists the questions and plans the reply.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Jibu la barua huanza kwa nini?" Kwa nini "malalamiko" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Jibu la barua hufanya nini kuhusu maswali?" Kwa nini "huyapuuza" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Lugha ya kujibu barua ya kirafiki ni ipi?" Kwa nini "ya kiofisi kali" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Lugha ni ya kirafiki na heshima.
Jibu la barua hujibu maswali na hoja za barua iliyopokelewa.

checks.question: Jibu la barua huanza baada ya salamu kwa nini?
checks.answer: kushukuru kwa barua na kujibu maswali yake

checks.question: Lugha ya kujibu barua ya kirafiki iweje?

skills.key_step: The child plans barua ya kirafiki before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Jibu kuhusu Mazoezi ya Viungo".

misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia lugha ya kirafiki: Mpendwa rafiki, Wako akupendaye.
Baada ya salamu, uliza hali ya rafiki yako kabla ya kueleza ujumbe.
Tarehe huandikwa chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, juu upande wa kulia.

misconceptions.ask: Rafiki yako anakuita kwa jina gani?
misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki humalizika kwa "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina la kwanza.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika barua ya kirafiki kuhusu "Jibu kuhusu Mazoezi ya Viungo"?
Barua ya kirafiki ina sehemu zipi?
